notes.title: German translation, Linux support and more!
notes.content:
[h2]New Supper Banana! Version 1.5.0[/h2]

New Supper Banana! arrives with a new update!

[h3]German translation[/h3]

The game is now available in the German language. It was translated by Yustin Ogrodowski.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40876007/ce25503432f20b816903d13f38bf8f92a84dbbbf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40876007/14138e80fffe33c617edc03279bf2f9677300bef.png[/img]

[h3]Linux support to Steam[/h3]

The Steam version of New Supper Banana! finally has native Linux support. (The itchio version already had it.) The game worked perfectly using Steam Play (proton), but a well supported native version is always better. For example, the game opens faster.

[h3]New hat in the Hat DLC[/h3]

To celebrate the launch of the Linux version, a new penguin hat was added to the Hat DLC.  Now your dreams of playing as a banana who has a penguin hat will be fulfilled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40876007/bb95954bd0725e5c0794140ae3771046ead469a2.gif[/img]

(Unfortunately the DLC doesn't seem to work on the Linux version. Will try to fix it soon.)

[h3]Bug fixes, optimization and other improvements[/h3]

Many bugs have been fixed and some optimization has been done, so there should be less frame drops on low end hardware.

Here is a detailed list of improvements:

[list]
[*] Added playstation controller instructions
[*] Added version number to main menu
[*] Updated credits
[*] Fixed in level 3: “You can climb the wall from the right side and stand above it, but you can’t drop down to the coin”
[*] Fixed in level 6: “You can climb the right wall of the coin and stand above it, but you can’t drop down to the coin”
[*] Fixed in level 6: “You can climb this wall and stand on it but if you go to the far right, you’ll drop down and can’t get back up again (you have to get back to the main menu)”
[*] Fixed in level 9: “The hitbox of the ground isn’t flat on this spot”
[*] Fixed in level 10: “The hitbox of the ground isn’t flat on this spot”
[*] Fixed crash when jumping towards falling spike enemy
[*] Fixed not being able to see intro cutscene completely if exited game during it
[*] Optimization
[*] Edited levelselect screen a little
[/list]

A sale will start later today.

notes.title: Soundtrack, new language and more
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

New Supper Banana! just got a cool update. Finnish language was added, there is a new setting and performance was improved. Also, the soundtrack is now available for purchase.

[h3]Soundtrack available[/h3]
The soundtrack of New Supper Banana! is now available on Steam. It consist of 7 songs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40876007/b3dd7020b25ad5532039bfa4d7ec9daa3c0b06aa.png[/img]

[h3]Finnish language[/h3]
The game is now available in Finnish. It was translated by me, Pikku-a. If you want to help translate it (for free) to your language, send me a message somewhere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40876007/5db76cd35c2ee7e38c81ea04bfe57b481b7c1526.png[/img]

[h3]New setting[/h3]
With a new setting you can disable the rain. This will make it possible to play the game a little better with older computers too. Also, more settings are now available in the pause menu (and not only in the main menu).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40876007/fbdacee4b82d9aeb348a97e2f58e6b7349f28f1a.png[/img]

[h3]Improved performance and bug fixes[/h3]
The performance was improved a little in the levels where there is rain. There were also some bug fixes and small improvements.
